name: BuildWithEhtisham Link Integrity Scanner
author: Ehtisham Ashraf

sections.description:
BuildWithEhtisham Link Integrity Scanner is a 100% local broken link checker for WordPress. Unlike cloud-based scanners that limit your site or require accounts, Link Integrity Scanner lives entirely on your server.

Key features:
* No accounts, API keys, or monthly limits.
* Gentle, batched link checking that respects your server resources.
* False-positive protection (two-failure rule for broken links).
* “Blocked” status for 403/429 responses.
* Scheduled automatic rescans (daily or weekly).
* Email digests of newly broken links.
* Redirect reporting: see every redirect chain and its final destination URL, and update links to the final URL in one click.
* CSV export of the full results list.
* Bulk URL replacement tool with a dry-run count before anything changes.
* Unlimited link checks — no caps, no credits. Every feature in this plugin is free.

LinkPilot Pro (optional add-on)

Want more than today’s results? LinkPilot Pro is an optional add-on that adds scan history & compare (see exactly what changed between scans), sitemap & full-site crawls, multisite roll-ups, and white-label PDF reports with your own branding — built for agencies and client work.
Learn more: https://buildwithehtisham.gumroad.com/l/linkpilot-pro
Everything in this free plugin is, and stays, completely free — Pro only adds new capabilities on top.
sections.installation:
1. Upload buildwithehtisham-link-integrity-scanner folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Link Integrity Scanner will start scanning automatically.
sections.faq:
Will it slow down my site?

No. Link Integrity Scanner uses gentle, background cron batches to keep load low.

Does it send my links to a cloud service?

No. 100% local.

Is there a limit on links?

No. Unlimited checks.

Why is a link marked “Blocked”?

Often means the target site is blocking automated scanners (403/429).

How do scheduled scans work?

WP-Cron fires in the background.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes — LinkPilot Pro is an optional add-on (scan history & compare, sitemap crawls, white-label PDF reports). Everything in this plugin is and stays free; Pro only adds new features on top.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Added: optional LinkPilot Pro add-on info (a dismissible notice on the plugin’s screens and a readme section). No feature changes — everything in this plugin stays free.

1.0.1

  • Renamed from LinkPilot for the WordPress.org review.
  • Fix: a link whose final response is an HTTP error (4xx/5xx, e.g. 400) is no longer labelled “OK” — it now follows the same two-failure rule as other error responses.
  • Readme wording correction in the feature list.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
